# Shreyash Pattewar

> Software Engineer (AI & Mobile) at Cognizant. Building mobile apps and AI agents.

Software engineer working at Cognizant on AI and mobile, passionate about building mobile apps and exploring the world of LLMs, AI agents, and MCP servers. I work with Kotlin, Swift, and Python to bring ideas to life.

Constantly exploring new tools and frameworks across mobile platforms. Open to collaborating on mobile app projects and anything at the intersection of mobile and AI. When I'm not coding, you'll find me swimming or playing ping pong.

## Projects

- [AI Foundation](https://aifoundation.web.app/lesson.html#kv-cache): A free, visual roadmap for learning AI and machine learning fundamentals — plain-language lessons paired with interactive animations, quizzes, and progress tracking. (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Firebase; source: )
- [DoTrack](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shreyash.dotrack): A modern task management Android app built with Clean Architecture and Jetpack Compose that turns your wallpaper into a dynamic to-do list. (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Hilt; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/DoTrack)
- [Sensor-App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shreyash.sensorapp): A Kotlin-based Android app for reading and visualizing device sensor data in real time. (Kotlin, Android Sensors; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/Sensor-App)
- [chatgpt-analysis](https://chatgpt-clone-app-lyart.vercel.app): A ChatGPT clone built with TypeScript — deployed on Vercel. Full-stack web exploration alongside mobile development. (TypeScript; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/chatgpt-analysis)
- [Anti-Theft-Alarm-App](https://github.com/shreyashp47/Anti-Theft-Alarm-App): An Android app that detects unauthorized device motion and triggers a loud alarm — built with Kotlin and device sensor integration. (Kotlin, Android Sensors; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/Anti-Theft-Alarm-App)
- [OpenCodeLeet](https://opencodeleet.onrender.com/): A local LeetCode-style coding challenge platform supporting Python and Kotlin. Solve algorithm problems in a web editor, run code against test cases, and get instant feedback. (Python, Flask, Kotlin, HTML, Tailwind CSS; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/OpenCodeLeet)
- [Shreyash-AI](https://github.com/shreyashp47/Shreyash-AI): AI-powered personal assistant exploring LLM agents, function calling, and MCP server integrations — built with Python. (Python, LLM, MCP; source: https://github.com/shreyashp47/Shreyash-AI)
